visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of yellow Meyer kitchenware items featuring Disney's Winnie the Pooh are displayed prominently on a shelf and a beige sofa in a brightly lit, home-like studio. The background features a white brick-patterned wall adorned with cartoon bee and honey jar stickers. Large orange and red text overlays announce the global first sale. (2) Close-up detailed shots focus on the individual pots and pans. One scene shows a vibrant yellow sauce pot decorated with white sketches of Winnie the Pooh and honey jars. Another macro shot reveals the interior of a pan featuring subtle, light grey floral patterns and character silhouettes against a smooth surface. (3) A middle-aged male chef wearing a white uniform with pink floral trim on the collar and sleeves holds a small yellow pot. He smiles broadly with an excited expression, tilting the pot to show its design. Large yellow variety-show style text bubbles pop up around his head to emphasize his enthusiasm. (4) A montage of cooking actions shows a person's hands using a large yellow wok on a black portable induction stove. Sliced green vegetables are tossed vigorously in the air within the pan. The camera zooms in on the ergonomic white handle, highlighting its design and the sturdy metal attachment point. (5) The chef stands behind a wooden table where the complete set of cookware is arranged neatly with their yellow and white packaging boxes. He holds a medium-sized pot and gestures with his free hand toward the camera, speaking energetically. Yellow informative text labels drift across the screen. (6) A close-up shot demonstrates the non-stick properties of the cookware. A single fried egg slides effortlessly across the light grey interior surface of a pan as it is tilted. The background consists of a bright orange and white checkered cloth, providing a high-contrast and domestic atmosphere. (7) A series of quick cuts presents the four available sizes of the cookware: an 18cm small pot, a 24cm deep pot, a 32cm stir-fry wok, and a 28cm flat pan. Each item is shown with its matching yellow lid. The yellow product boxes with Pooh graphics are stacked behind the items. (8) The chef holds a packaged gift box while wearing a joyful expression. He gestures with the box towards the viewers. Bright yellow text bubbles with radiating light effects appear, highlighting a special "Fan Benefit" promotion. The background remains the cozy, well-lit studio environment with brick walls. (9) Close-up of the chef's hands wearing oversized white oven mitts designed to resemble Mickey Mouse's iconic gloved hands. He playfully waves both hands at the camera in a greeting gesture, adding a whimsical element to the promotion. His chef's jacket remains clean and professional. (10) The chef stands in a medium full shot with his arms spread wide, showcasing the entire product line laid out on the table before him. The scene is framed symmetrically. Final bold text overlays with a call to action and specific website URL appear at the bottom of the screen.
